cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll prepare your dinners for a week. Label portions by date, please; guessing isn't meal planning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm up, I'll fill yours for a month. Properly portioned; we won't waste your space on half-empty tubs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send me the measurements for a bigger freezer. Height, width and depth, please. I'll return your tubs full inside it.

reason: Remove the unestablished alcove and hope maxim; the larger gift now has a straightforward complete measurement request and directly includes B requested tubs.
